plate.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent photographic ceramic plate base for a 2D Chinese home meal planner, to be composited underneath real food cutouts. Primary request: one EMPTY shallow round cream-white ceramic dinner plate, photographed from 70 degrees above the table (near overhead, slight perspective, ellipse width about 1.15 times height), complete plate entirely visible, centered with 12 percent transparent padding on every edge. Natural handmade high-quality everyday ceramics, subtly speckled warm ivory glaze, fine thin rim with believable small thickness, slight graceful asymmetry, warm-white center with a delicate soft natural reflection. The plate's actual food well should be broad and clean, about 82 percent of its diameter, so food can occupy the left half and upper/lower right quadrants. Lighting: large window daylight from upper left, soft restrained contact shadow immediately under the bottom right edge, realistic glaze and microtexture, professional food editorial photography. Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, nothing around it. No food, no compartments, no utensils, no flowers, no napkin, no table surface, no background color or checkerboard, no logos or text. Avoid CGI, 3D cartoon, toy/plastic material, thick inflated rim, dramatic perspective, square tray, black shadow, circular graphic/disc, artificial radial gradient. Final image should look exactly like a real photographed empty ceramic plate isolated on transparency.

table.purpose: subtle matching linen dining surface background
table.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: restrained dining surface background for a private Sichuan home meal planner; a real photographic plate cutout will be overlaid at the center by the app. Primary request: a beautiful quiet creamy oatmeal-colored linen tablecloth photographed nearly overhead from 70 degrees, in a softly lit home kitchen. Composition: wide landscape 3:2, only clean linen fabric, fully EMPTY center and all foreground; very subtle large organic soft folds crossing diagonally only at far top-left and bottom-right edges, extremely fine visible linen weave, genuine warm daylight from upper left and very gentle diffused leaf shadow confined to the far top-left corner. Keep lighting very even, warm off-white neutral color so green vegetables and a cream plate will look good against it. No plate, food, tableware, glassware, flowers, furniture, borders, text, logo or watermark. Not an illustration or render, real natural fabric photography with detail, understated premium everyday kitchen mood. Avoid strong wrinkle lines, large dark shadows, exaggerated vignette or gradients.
